Maya Chen: Quick sync — we need final hero + CTA approach for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages before copy freeze tomorrow. Two asks: (1) hero lines for each mode, (2) demo vs webinar gating + inbound routing. Thoughts?
Samir Patel: +1. I'll pull the benchmark narratives. Suggest we keep one shared hero frame, mode-specific subheads. Demo CTA for Hosted, sales-qualify form for Dedicated, webinar for Private?
Aria Gomez: Drafting options now. High-level split: capability-first, economics-first, security-first. Quick heuristics: Hosted = low friction, Dedicated = predictable ops + SLA, Private = compliance-first.
Leo Park: Routing thoughts — Hosted demo signups -> marketing SDR queue; Dedicated form -> AE routing based on company size & expected QPS; Private -> enterprise ops handoff. Add UTM params `?m=hosted|dedicated|private` for attribution.
Kris O'Neill: For gating: don't force form on Hosted landing. Use 1-click demo modal + calendar booking. Dedicated: require contact form (company, company_size, infra preference, target QPS). Private: request demo + NDA checkbox and account manager checkbox.
Maya Chen: Love it. Aria — can you produce 3 hero variants for each page (capability/economics/security) + 1-line subheads by EOD? Samir — can you share short benchmark snippets we can surface as bullets under each hero?
Aria Gomez: Yup. Quick sketch for Hosted hero options:
- Capability: "Start generating in minutes — predictable, low-latency inference."
- Economics: "High-throughput inference, lower unit cost at scale."
- Simplicity: "One API, immediate results."
I'll do similar for Dedicated & Private.
Samir Patel: Quick bullets to use: Hosted — p50 latency ~120ms for standard text gen (avg token). Dedicated — predictable throughput, customizable autoscaling, SLA-backed targets. Private — VPC, KMS/HSM integrations, SOC2+audit logs. I'll clean numbers for the copy.
deploy-bot: Preview deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/tri-mode-hero-preview (expires in 72h) :rocket:
Leo Park: QA/routing note — ensure form fields map directly to HubSpot: `company_name`, `company_size`, `use_case`, `expected_qps`, `infra_preference`. Also include hidden `product_mode` field set by page.
Kris O'Neill: Webinar playbook: Host 3 short sessions (Hosted deep-dive, Dedicated ops Q&A, Private compliance invite-only). Use webinar regs as gated lead-gen for Private. For Hosted, use on-demand recording CTA after sign-up.
Maya Chen: Next steps: Aria publish variants -> tag recommended hero. Samir finalize numeric bullets. Leo + Kris confirm routing field list. I'll consolidate and freeze copy tomorrow AM.
Aria Gomez: Uploaded draft variants: drive.link/tri-mode-hero-variants — please comment inline.
Samir Patel: Uploaded benchmark snippets: drive.link/benchmarks-snippets — ping if you need raw tables.
Leo Park: Routing spec updated: drive.link/inbound-routing-mapping — includes hubspot field names + AE routing rules.
Kris O'Neill: I'll draft webinar registration page copy + demo modal microcopy and post for review.
Maya Chen: Thanks all — tiny design ask: keep CTA color consistent across modes but tweak microcopy (Demo vs Request demo vs Request webinar). Reaction if you approve the plan :+1:
